title: Candidate conditional kappa 0.001017786140030308: enlarged entrances and target prefixes
body:

**Frontier update:** newly published #416 reports `0.001017798035290733`, slightly above this result. This PR remains a verified local component improvement over #412, but is not the current numeric leader.

Compose an eighth entrance-space enlargement on #413 with #411's target124/144 prefix rewrite. The eighth enlargement becomes profitable only after the seven earlier moves share donor advances; its local delta is `{1:+2,3:-1}`. The target rewrite adds `{1:-1,3:-1,4:+1}`. Both changes are applied to one literal word and priced from its regenerated exact profile.

**Passed before draft:** complete1021-column/retained-total equality for the enlargement; protected X/Y/gauged-helper columns and unchanged source/helper cleanup for the prefix rewrite; all204 gauged zero-response columns; complete nested paths; chronological source-before-write premise; exact residual packing; two rational moment engines and47 strict outer inequalities. The nongauged dirty response changes and is explicitly reopened.

**Pending at draft submission:** recomputed-response scalar admission in both formal orientations; quarter/eighth coefficient microcheck; changed Gaussian phases; actual physical owner/padding assembly and independent decoder; regenerated finite invoice/bridge; fresh bit composition and the full Python3.11/3.14 wrapper. The32-replica schedule uses2943 banks per stage,1495 rank-one pads,live57207,physical57998. Exact complex lower:`1018823084044392067721/1000000000000000000000000`. Unchanged bit lower:`255384852701747/250000000000000000`.

Run `python -B research/e8-enlarged-prefixes/verify.py /tmp/enlarged-prefixes`. It freshly runs all of #413, then this changed construction and bit composition. All seven package manifests are checked before/after. #413's complete changed local/phase/global/invoice build has passed locally; its full wrapper/CI remain pending. #409's prior full local attempt stopped on SSD exhaustion at the final link step, with its separate fresh bit run passing; no parent full-wrapper pass is invented here.

This does **not** assert unchanged legacy gx/gxcore acceptance. Inherited target overlap and quarter/eighth primitive sequences use the stated exact chronological/dyadic framework. All-size window, arbitrary dirty-bank, compiler, fixed-tape, restored-row, common-grid, precision and analytic interfaces remain conditional. No Lean certificate or unconditional multiplication theorem.

Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit eumemic #411 for target-prefix recipes, recomputed-response admission and explicit lowering (all local verifier/dependency bytes retained); #413/#409 for enlarged/ordered gauges; chafreaky #402 for the prefix-window method and #412 for the comparator; Dugongue #404/#401; #403 physical banks; applecrusher #376 and earlier E8 lineage.
